E2-2022-T2-P1-S3.trunk: S+V+C：Even more surprising is that more than half... said...（更令人惊讶的是，超过半数的人表示……）
structure: 主句：Even more surprising is that-clause
└ 表语从句(that)：more than half of "unretirees" said
├ 同位解释：those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring
├ 宾语从句：they would be employed in their later years
└ 让步条件从句(even if)：even if they had enough money to settle down
E2-2022-T2-P1-S3.logic: that 从句承载“令人惊讶”的具体内容；破折号解释 unretirees；said 后的宾语从句给出选择，even if 则排除“缺钱才工作”这一单一解释。
notes: unretirees 是文中造词，指退休后继续或重新工作的人。
settle down 在此指经济无忧地安顿下来、停止奔波。
the survey showed 是信息来源插入语，可前置翻译。

E2-2022-T2-P1-S15.trunk: S+V+O：Americans are boosting their savings（美国人正在增加储蓄）
structure: 原因状语：Because of longer life spans
主句：Americans are also boosting their savings
└ 目的状语(to)：to preserve their nest eggs
插入式来源：the TD Ameritrade study showed
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which surveyed 2,000 adults between 40 to 79
E2-2022-T2-P1-S15.logic: because of 给出行为动因，不定式说明增加储蓄的目的；后半部分补充研究来源和样本信息，阅读时应先抓住 Americans are boosting... 的主干。
notes: nest egg 指为将来尤其是退休准备的储蓄。
preserve 在此不是一般的“保护”，而是“保住、不消耗”。
which 语义上指 TD Ameritrade study。

E2-2022-T2-P1-S17.trunk: 倒装：Among the most popular ways... is by reducing..., securing... or maximizing...（最常见的方式包括……）
structure: 前置介词短语：Among the most popular ways they are doing this
系表主干：is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions
└ 介词短语：to retirement accounts〔修饰 contributions〕
E2-2022-T2-P1-S17.logic: 为承接上文，Among... 被置于句首；真正列举方法的是 by 后三个并列动名词 reducing、securing、maximizing。单数 is 与形式上的中心表达保持一致。
notes: do this 指上文的 increasing their savings。
make/maximize contributions to retirement accounts 指向退休账户缴款。
secure life insurance 可译为“购买/获得人寿保险”。
